description:
Get one stock's record as its stock page states it: how many times the model called it long or short and how
    many of those calls were hits. The sealed tallies (books from sealed_from, sealed before their outcomes) are the
    headline, with the long and short split; the reconstructed and backtest tallies are older books, each under its own
    label, and are never added to the sealed ones. Also the best call, the worst miss, the newest sealed call and every
    call with its day, newest first, through the newest date by which every book is graded. Use this for a stock's
    hit rate, get_stock_resolved_history for every day it was ranked, and explain_resolved_prediction for the evidence
    behind one call. A ticker with no row in any graded book is an error.

ticker.description: Stock ticker, for example AAPL. Upper or lower case both work.
ticker.title: Ticker
